quality_boundary: Current plan identity kept as published (the Otsu City Comprehensive Plan composed of the Basic Concept (FY2017-FY2028; future city image 『ひと、自然、歴史の縁で織りなす 住み続けたいまち“大津再生” ～コンパクトで持続可能なまちへの変革～』 with three basic principles) and the Action Plans that divide the Basic Concept period into three four-year terms, the current one being the Third Action Plan (FY2025-FY2028) holding three basic directions, 13 basic policies and 32 measures, all enumerated; the first and second action plans are kept only as separate versions, and the status of the next comprehensive plan after the Basic Concept period is left unconfirmed), progress governance (administrative evaluation — comprehensive-plan progress management and project evaluation — published annually as the municipality's own progress-management route), budget enactment kept as passed on 2026-03-25 as bill No. 3 at the February 2026 regular session with the amount kept at the published sen-yen precision and never expanded into synthetic yen (the council's published result wording is only '可決（多数）' and the wording '原案可決' is not asserted), and settlement totals kept at the published yen precision from the official settlement book (bill No. 110 certified on 2025-10-28; the real balance of 2,791,920 thousand yen is kept at sen-yen precision as published in the audit commissioners' settlement review opinion, and the yen value in the real-balance statement itself is left unconfirmed) without collapsing proposed, enacted, supplementary, or settlement states.
